nota: Words of this language that look borrowed from another language but do not exist there with that meaning, grouped by the language they imitate.

parole.testo: Pseudo-anglicism, derived from after-party.

parole.testo: Pseudo-anglicism, derived from peddy + English paper, influenced by French rallie-papier.

parole.testo: Borrowed from French playback, and this a pseudo-anglicism, derived from English playback.

parole.significato: a location where members of a group usually meet

parole.testo: Pseudo-anglicism, derived from roller.

parole.significato: hentai (a work of anime or manga—Japanese cartoon art, respectively animated and static—that contains pornography)
